{{Quote|They could be a lot better, but they could also be a lot worse. They need a full medical lab, but they should hang in there until we can reach a Republic spaceport.''"<br />"''Then let's move out. Good work, team.|[[Jortan]] and [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]]|<ref name="CM" />}}
During the [[Thrawn campaign]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], a '''mission''' was undertaken by [[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hettsk]] to rescue two [[New Republic pilot/Legends|New Republic pilots]] of [[Gold Squadron (New Republic)|Gold Squadron]], [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commander]] [[Greni]] and her [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] [[Bross]], in the aftermath of a massive space and ground [[Battle of Hettsk|battle]] won by [[Thrawn's confederation]].
